anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Continuous convex curvature with a broad radius defining the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Tapered triangular projection with a pixel length-to-base-thickness ratio of approximately 1.1:1.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 165 degrees where the melon gradient transitions to the rostrum.
